meta.name: llm-gate
meta.description: LLM-powered quality verification using prompt hooks. Validates commit messages, code patterns, and conventions using AI before allowing operations. Use to set up intelligent guardrails.

copy.tagline: 用AI自动验证提交信息与代码规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在提交代码前自动检查质量与规范
copy.tagline_en: Automatically validate commits and code conventions with AI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI-powered guardrails for code quality before commits

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在执行 git 提交、删除文件、写入文件等操作前，自动用 AI 检查是否符合规则（如提交格式、安全风险），不符合则阻止操作并给出原因。
howto.when: 当你执行 git commit、rm 等命令，或写入文件时，如果触发了预设的钩子条件，就会自动进行 AI 验证。

say.text: 添加一个钩子，防止我误删 src 目录。
设置一个钩子，阻止写入包含 API 密钥的文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically uses AI to verify operations like git commits, file deletions, and file writes against predefined rules (e.g., commit format, security risks). It blocks the operation and provides a reason if the check fails.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run commands like git commit, rm, or write files, if the preset hook conditions are met. The AI validation runs automatically before the operation proceeds.

say_en.text: Set up a hook to check git commits follow conventional commit format.
say_en.note: Claude adds a prompt hook that validates commit messages on each git commit.

say_en.text: Add a hook to prevent accidental deletion of the src directory.
say_en.note: Claude creates a hook that warns when rm targets important directories.

say_en.text: Set up a hook to block writes containing API keys.
say_en.note: Claude adds a Write hook that checks file content for hardcoded secrets.
